module.summary: Inline bounded sequence with explicit initialized length and no allocation.
module.long_description: Inline bounded sequence with explicit initialized length and no allocation.

purpose.primary: Store up to a compile-time capacity of values while exposing only initialized elements.

c_pain.summary: C fixed arrays often rely on separate informal length conventions and unchecked writes.
common_failure_modes: caller and container disagree about active length
c_pain.why_c_is_attractive: A C array plus size_t length is compact and direct.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: The invariants remain conventions repeated at every call site rather than properties defended by one type.

zig_response.summary: A comptime-generated type keeps capacity in the type, length in state, and insertion failure explicit.
guarantees_made_visible: len never exceeds capacity after successful operations
only initialized elements are exposed as a slice
full insertion is an explicit error
remaining_programmer_responsibilities: perform element-level cleanup when T owns resources
